source_documents.title: Effect of halide substitution on photophysical, solvatochromic, fluorescence and intramolecular charge transfer characteristics of phenylazo acetylphenol dyes: Experimental and DFT studies

reference_evidence_units.quote: Fluorescence quantum yields and estimated lifetimes showed considerable heavy-atom effects, with Br derivatives exhibiting improved intersystem crossing (up to 2.11 × 1011 s− 1 in n-hexane) as calculated from steady state spectroscopic data.
reference_evidence_units.subject: F/Cl/Br-PAAP
reference_evidence_units.statement: ISC rates rise from F to Br (derived, not measured).
reference_evidence_units.limitations: ISC rates derived from steady-state data; no triplet measurement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: dipole moment analyses suggest a gradual increase in excited-state po larity from F to Br
reference_evidence_units.subject: F/Cl/Br-PAAP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Excited-state dipole rises with heavier halogen.

reference_evidence_units.quote: because the solvatochromic analysis is limited to a small number of solvents, the observed trends should be seen as suggestive rather than generalizable
reference_evidence_units.subject: F/Cl/Br-PAAP
